body.title: League of Legends: Worlds Winner 2024
body.description: This is a market group over which team will win the 2024 Season World Championship (Worlds 2024) for League of Legends.

markets.question: Will Hanwha Life Esports win LoL Worlds 2024?
markets.description:
The League of Legends World Championship 2024 is scheduled to conclude on November 2, 2024. You can find more information about that tournament here: https://lolesports.com/en-US?leagues=lcs,worlds

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Hanwha Life Esports wins this tournament. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If this team is eliminated from the competition based on the official rules of the tournament, this market will resolve to “No”.

If the winner of The League of Legends World Championship 2024 is not determined by November 30, 2024 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information provided directly from Riot Games (e.g. lolesports.com) and official footage of the tournament, however other credible reporting may be used.

body.title: LEC: G2 Esports vs. GIANTX
body.description:
G2 Esports and GIANTX are scheduled to play each other in a regular season matchup of the League of Legends EMEA Championship League on April 26, 2025, at 9:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to “G2 Esports” if G2 Esport wins against GIANTX in the best of 3, week 5 matchup of the League of Legends EMEA Championship league.

This market will resolve to “GIANTX” if GIANTX wins against G2 Esports in the best of 3, week 5 matchup of the League of Legends EMEA Championship league.

If the match ends in a tie, is canceled, or delayed beyond May 28, 2025, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the LoL Esports (https://lolesports.com/en-GB/leagues/lec).
